name: 19-(4-hydroxyphenyl)nonadecanoyl-AMP
definition: An acyclic mixed acid anhydride that results from the formal condensation of the phosphoryl group of AMP with the carboxy group of 19-(4-hydroxyphenyl)nonadecanoic acid.

name: (E,E)-2-methyl-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienal
definition: A heptadienal that is hepta-2,4-dienal substituted by an oxo group at position 6 and a methyl group at position 2.

name: n-alkanal
definition: An  aliphatic aldehyde obtained by formal oxygenation of one of the terminal methyl groups of any straight-chain alkane.

name: disodium cromoglycate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of cromoglycic acid.

name: valienol 1-phosphate
definition: A cyclitol phosphate that is valienol carrying a sigle monophosphate group at position 1.

name: (2E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-enyl diphosphate(3-)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the trianion of (2E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-enyl diphosphate arising from deprotonation of the three OH groups of the diphosphate.

name: GDP-valienol
definition: A nucleotide conjugate consisting of CDP joined at the 1-position of valienol via a diphosphate linkage.

name: isopentenyl diphosphate(3-)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the trianion of isopentenyl diphosphate arising from deprotonation of the three OH groups of the diphosphate.

name: 12,18-dihydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A long-chain fatty acid that is octadecanoic (stearic) acid substituted at positions 12 and 18 by hydroxy groups.
